dialogues.speaker: Winslow
dialogues.text: They're finally gone... whew. All those alarms...

dialogues.speaker: Winslow
dialogues.text: Couldn't be better. No more warning lights flashing in the middle of the night, so the lighthouse walls aren't constantly flickering anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Winslow
dialogues.text: I can finally sleep through the night.

dialogues.speaker: Winslow
dialogues.text: *sigh* They take up a lot of space. I used to think about moving them. I mean, this is where I live now. It's my place, right?

dialogues.speaker: Winslow
dialogues.text: Thinking back, I see how selfish I was being...

dialogues.speaker: Winslow
dialogues.text: So I clean them every day now. They haven't acted up since.

dialogues.speaker: Winslow
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I find myself wondering... If the Abyss really does come one day, maybe they'll see how hard I've been keeping things clean and look out for me a bit. I mean... it's not impossible, right?

dialogues.speaker: Winslow
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I hope everything goes well for you...
